official_definition: By sending the 20px from your Reserve/Trash to a "Thunderive" family Spirit, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultra Thunder Advent] or [Ultra Thunder Advent: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultra Thunder Advent]", "give [Ultra Thunder Advent]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
